title: Zesty French Olives Eclair
description: Bitter green olives and low-fat cheese baked inside a crisp eclair-shaped pastry using pasta-water emulsion, served from a dolsot stone bowl.
instructions: Preheat oven to 200 and place a dolsot stone bowl inside to heat for 10 minutes.
Whisk whole wheat flour, baking powder, salt, and black pepper in a bowl until combined.
Add the egg white, olive oil, and pasta water to the dry ingredients, stirring until a soft dough forms.
Knead the dough on a lightly floured surface for 2 minutes, then roll to a one-centimetre thickness.
Cut the dough into eight equal rectangles (about 5x10 cm) to create the eclair shapes.
Combine chopped olives, shredded cheeses, thyme, and lemon zest in a small bowl, mixing until evenly coated.
Place a spoonful of the olive-cheese filling onto each rectangle, fold the edges over to seal, and twist the top like a pastry eclair.
Arrange the assembled eclairs on a parchment-lined sheet and bake in the preheated dolsot for 15 minutes until golden and the cheese melts.
